title: Dark Ambient

lyrics:
[Intro]

[Verse1]
Moonlight bathes my silent frame
Eyes awake through endless storm
Hunger burns like silver fire
For the crimson thirst's desire

[Pre-Chorus]
Life's a chain of centuries past
Watching mortals fade so fast
Shadows weave a cloak of frost
In this night where I am lost

[Chorus]
Lord of darkness, cold and grand
Every heartbeat in my hand
Yet each pulse leaves me frozen still
As time defies my will

Lord of shadows, old and wise
Every kiss a sweet demise
Yet each touch turns cold as stone
In this night I call my own

[Interlude]

[Verse2]
Ancient castles hold my pain
